addAgent(address).details: Add an agent authorized to manage the token

params.agent: Address of the agent to add

burn(address,uint256).details: Burn tokens from a specified address

canTransfer(address,address,uint256).details: Check if a transfer between two addresses is allowed

compliance().details: Get the address of the Compliance module

params._supplyCap: Maximum token supply (represents full vehicle value in smallest units)

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

freePartialTokens(address,uint256).details: Freeze a specific amount of tokens for an address

params.userAddress: Address whose tokens are to be frozen

frozenTokens(address).details: Get the amount of frozen tokens for a specific address

params.userAddress: Address to query frozen tokens for

getFreeBalance(address).details: Get the free balance of tokens for a specific address

params.userAddress: Address to query free balance for

identityRegistry().details: Get the address of the Identity Registry

investorTypeRegistry().details: Get the address of the Investor Type Registry

returns._0: Address of the Investor Type Registry

mint(address,uint256).details: Overrides base Token mint to enforce supply cap

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

removeAgent(address).details: Remove an agent authorized to manage the token

params.agent: Address of the agent to remove

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAddressFrozen(address,bool).details: Set the frozen status of an address

params.investorTypeRegistryAddress: Address of the Investor Type Registry

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Moves a `value` amount of tokens from the caller's account to `to`. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Moves a `value` amount of tokens from `from` to `to` using the allowance mechanism. `value` is then deducted from the caller's allowance. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unfreezePartialTokens(address,uint256).details: Unfreeze a specific amount of tokens for an address
